name: Urine creatinine
rangeNote: There is no single normal range for a spot urine sample, because it depends mostly on how much you drank. In a large US survey (NHANES III, ages 6–90), 8 in 10 random samples were between about 3 and 21 mmol/L (34–237 mg/dL); men, younger adults and people with more muscle tend to be higher. The lab's own range is used when it gives one.
summary: Creatinine is a waste product from muscles that the kidneys pass into the urine at a fairly steady rate. In a spot urine sample it mainly shows how concentrated the urine is, so labs use it to correct other urine results, such as albumin, for dilution.

high.meaning: A high urine creatinine usually means concentrated urine, for example in a first-morning sample or after drinking little. On its own it says little about kidney health.
commonCauses: Concentrated urine (first-morning sample, drinking little, sweating)

low.meaning: A low urine creatinine usually means dilute urine after drinking a lot. Very dilute samples can make other urine results less reliable, so a lab may ask for a new sample.
commonCauses: Dilute urine after drinking a lot
